Name: Sprinkler Mod Redux
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[center][/center][center][b][size=5]﻿This is an update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15385]Sprinkler Mod[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for 1.6[/size]
[/b][/center]
This mod lets you change the radii of vanilla sprinklers and lets non-sprinkler objects function as sprinklers by giving them radii as well.

It also lets you manually activate all sprinklers in the current location by pressing a hotkey (default [b]Enter[/b]), or individually by hovering over the sprinkler and pressing a hotkey (default [b]Right Mouse[/b]).

[b][size=4]Config:[/size][/b]
The mod's config file has radii for the three vanilla sprinklers in it. Change the number to whatever whole number you like. You can also add a new entry for a custom sprinkler object.

Sprinklers with radius of 0 function like the ordinary vanilla sprinkler, with four water animations, all higher radii result in the single circular water animation.

Example custom sprinkler object:
"Solid Gold Lewis": 5

Radii and hotkeys can be configured with GMCM, but adding new custom sprinkler requires manual editing of the config.json.

[size=3][b]Content packs should still function properly with the old method:
[/b][/size]Create a Content Pack targeting the dictionary at aedenthorn.SprinklerMod/dictionary. The dictionary has the same format as the config file dictionary.[size=3][b]
[/b][/size]
